summary: The mechanism this feature targets (OpenRouter usage.include=true opt-in, the _invoke_and_record choke point, CostEntry writes with source=openrouter_direct) was already implemented on this branch before the pipeline began. This feature's real, delivered scope was closing a genuine test-coverage gap on that extraction path (5 new tests in TestInvokeAndRecord) and fixing a real bug the test-writing surfaced: explicit JSON null in token_usage/cost/prompt_tokens_details fields previously raised AttributeError via .get(key, {}) and silently dropped a valid CostEntry, now fixed via .get(key) or {}. Exception log level also bumped from debug to warning for visibility. All 48 tests in test_cost_tracking.py pass (102 across the full cost/budget surface). No new mypy errors, no critical/high security findings, architectural and adversarial review both closed clean.
